blocks.text: Basking in the spotlight of a breakout year, Chinese-American alternative pop singer/songwriter Emei uncovers her anxiously awaited new 2-pack Night At The Opera: Intermission out now via Atlantic Records in partnership with multi-GRAMMY® Award-winning mega-producer Ricky Reed’s Nice Life. Listen HERE. The project notably boasts her bombastic and blunt new single “Regularly Scheduled Program.” Watch the accompanying visualizer HERE. She stoked anticipation for the song’s arrival by previewing it on tour to a groundswell of enthusiasm from fans.
